title: Record page inline edit of a datetime field drops its time: InlineFieldInput edits it through a date-only control and saves local midnight (the last inline editor still on the native date input)
body:
Filing gate ①: an out-of-scope finding from the os-dev on objectui#12664 (PR #12756, report `6221935199`). The seat confirmed it by reading the source on `main`. Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`). ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route.

## What is wrong (read on objectui `main`)

`packages/plugin-detail/src/InlineFieldInput.tsx` (around `:548`–`:580`) routes `date` **and** `datetime` fields to `@object-ui/fields`' `DateField`, which is an `<input type="date">`, a day-only control. For `datetime` it writes:

```ts
onChange={(v) => onChange(isDateTime && v ? new Date(v + 'T00:00:00').toISOString() : v)}
```

So on the record page (the details section and the header highlights, both of which mount `InlineFieldInput`), an inline edit of a `datetime` field:
- shows no time at all, and
- saves **local midnight** of the picked day, dropping whatever time the record held.

The source comment says it outright: "A `datetime` field still re-emits local midnight as an ISO instant … objectui#12206 left that arm unchanged."

This is the same class as objectui#3569 (a datetime collapsed to a date control, so the time is silently lost on edit), on another editor.

The control also takes its placeholder and digit order from the machine's locale, not the console's (the objectui#12622 class). After objectui#12664 (PR #12756), this is the last inline editor still drawing the native date input.

## Reach

- Every record page whose details section or header highlight shows an editable `datetime` field.
- One inline edit of the day loses the stored time.
- Not yet measured through a browser. The finding is from reading the source, and the seat confirmed it on `main`.

## Done when

- An inline `datetime` edit on the record page keeps the time: it edits date and time through a datetime-capable control, and it never re-emits local midnight.
- The editor draws the platform date picker that forms, dialogs, grid cells and the kanban dialog already draw (objectui#12622 / #12642 / #12664), with its placeholder in the console locale.
- `date` fields keep writing `YYYY-MM-DD` unchanged (objectui#12206).
- The impossible-stored-day notice (objectui#10625 / #10567) is preserved.

Pins:
- A `datetime` record at 14:30, edited inline to another day, saves that day at 14:30, or the time the user set.
- CONTROL: a `date` field writes `YYYY-MM-DD`.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` in objectui with "record detail inline edit datetime field loses time writes local midnight InlineFieldInput DateField" returned 9 hits, all closed. The nearest are:
- objectui#12206 (the `date` arm, fixed);
- objectui#3569 (the same class in the subtable);
- objectui#10625 (impossible day).

None of them covers the `datetime` arm.

`domain:ui` · `area:records`.
